getApp.body.en:
Reporting waits and problems is only available in the PickupRadar mobile app.

The preview on this website is read-only.
getApp.body.text:
Eegumsaa fi rakkoo gabaasuun kan danda’amu appii moobaayilaa PickupRadar qofa keessatti.

Agarsiisni marsariitii kana irratti ilaaluuf qofa.

getApp.cityAlert.en:

getApp.cityRequest.en:
Ask for PickupRadar in your city.

City requests are sent from the mobile app.
getApp.cityRequest.text:
Magaalaa keetti PickupRadar gaafadhu.

Gaaffiin magaalaa appii moobaayilaa irraa ergama.
